mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 43 degrees with clear skies at Badger Ridge Middle School.

October is Community Planning Month, a time to recognize the Planning and Development Department for their dedication. Also, if you need a scenic outing, you can now book free rides on the tri-shaw Bike at the Senior Center.
Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, and on Wednesday, Paddy Mac's hosts both trivia and live music.
On September 21, a retail theft involving Swedish Fish candy occurred at a store in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue, and the individual was identified via surveillance video.
You can enjoy today's flavor, Chocolate Caramel Twist, when the store opens today at 10 AM. The shop will remain open until 10 PM.
